notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: nefesh em i win bilong laip, tasol Tok Pisin 'bel' i holim tingting na laik klosu liklik

notes.subject: נודו הרכם צפור
notes.rationale: KJV 'flee as a bird to your mountain' vs LXX/Peshitta 'flee to your mountain like a bird' — hadir i stap: maunten bilong wanem, balus i go long maunten o man i olsem balus

notes.subject: tok bilong ol birua
notes.rationale: Familia i putim tok bilong ol birua long salm — ol i kolim man long ranawe

translation: Bilong man i lidim miusik. Salm bilong David. Long Yahwe mi ran malolo; olsem wanem yu tokim bel bilong mi: Ran olsem balus i go long maunten bilong yu!
